links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and lack of false information in LLM T2DM answers versus Chinese guideline
links.effect: All four models scored in the 'very good' CLEAR range (19-25); no significant difference in Lack of false information (χ2 = 7.644, p = 0.054) or total score (p = 0.576).
links.quote: All four models achieved total CLEAR scores within the "very good" range (19-25), with no significant differences seen between models (χ2 = 1.985, p = 0.576).

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the quality, completeness, and understandability of responses from four different LLMs against clinical guidelines for diabetes patient education using expert evaluators, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
